FROM plano p JOIN aluno a ON a.id_plano = p.id_plano
WHERE a.ativo = 1

ORDER BY arrecadacao DESC;

t4.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checkin WHERE YEAR(data_hora) = 2025 AND MONTH(data_hora) = 3;
